title: UUID Generator
description: Generate UUIDv4 values in the browser, copy one or many identifiers, and choose hyphenated or compact formats.
metaDescription: Generate UUIDv4 values in the browser, copy one or many identifiers, and choose hyphenated or compact formats.

form.title: Generate UUIDs
form.description: Create UUIDv4 identifiers locally, one at a time or in bulk, without saving generated values.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose how many UUIDs to create and how they should appear for copying.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.help: Generate from 1 to {max} UUIDs at a time.

formats.label: Format
formats.description: The transform changes display only; the generated base remains canonical UUIDv4.

uppercase.label: Use uppercase
uppercase.description: Converts the entire output to uppercase, including the URN prefix when used.

share.title: Share
share.description: The shared link recreates only the settings and generates a fresh list for whoever opens it.
share.safe: The current link includes only quantity, format, and uppercase. Generated UUIDs stay out of the URL.

privacy.title: Privacy and security
privacy.browser: Generation happens in the browser with Web Crypto. This tool does not send generated UUIDs to the server.
privacy.secret: UUIDs are identifiers, not passwords, secret tokens, encryption keys, or authorization grants.

result.title: Generated UUIDs
result.description: Each generation creates a fresh list. Changing format only transforms the current display.
result.empty: Click generate to create a new list.
result.unsupportedEmpty: This browser does not provide Web Crypto for secure UUID generation.
result.disclaimer: Do not place generated UUIDs in public links after they represent real records or private data.

warnings.unsupportedDescription: This browser provides neither crypto.randomUUID nor crypto.getRandomValues. Update the browser or use a secure context.
warnings.capped: Quantity was limited to {max} UUIDs per generation.

layout.title: UUIDv4
layout.description: Version 4 uses random bytes with fixed version and variant markers from the current UUID standard.

formats.title: Output formats
formats.description: Use standard hyphenated text for common APIs, no hyphens for compact fields, or URN when a system expects that prefix.

security.title: Identifier, not secret
security.description: UUIDs have a low collision chance, but they should not control access or replace purpose-built random tokens.

what.question: What is a UUID?
what.answer: A UUID is a 128-bit identifier used to name records, objects, and events with a low chance of collision.

v4.question: Does the generator create UUIDv4 values?
v4.answer: Yes. This version generates random UUIDv4 values only, with version and variant bits set before display.

privacy.question: Are UUIDs sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Generation happens in the browser, and generated values do not enter the URL, hash, favorites, or server state.

secret.question: Can I use a UUID as a password or secret token?
secret.answer: Not recommended. UUIDs are identifiers. Use password or purpose-built token generators for credentials and authorization.

formats.question: What is the difference between formats?
formats.answer: Standard keeps hyphens, no hyphens compacts the text, and URN adds the urn:uuid: prefix for systems that expect that format.

sharing.question: Does the shared link include generated UUIDs?
sharing.answer: No. The link includes only quantity, format, and uppercase settings. Whoever opens it gets a fresh list.

seo.about: The generator creates UUIDv4 values in the browser with Web Crypto, supports bulk quantity, individual or full-list copy, and standard, no-hyphen, or URN formats. Generated values are not saved or sent by the app.
seo.howToUse: Choose the quantity, select the format, enable uppercase if needed, and copy one UUID or the full list. The shared link preserves only settings and generates new UUIDs when opened.
